plan.voiceover:
[conversational] Those ChatGPT slash commands for product photos? They're not real.

[serious] Slash product photography, slash flash sale... none of them are documented commands. ChatGPT just reads them as a normal request.

Here's the 3-step way. [confident] One: new chat, tap the plus button, upload one clear, well-lit snapshot.

Two: paste a prompt. "Using the photo I uploaded, make a pure white background product shot. Keep shape, color and logo unchanged." For a mannequin shot, add "using my original uploaded photo" and "change the setting, not the product." Use a display stand if it's not clothing. For a poster, ask for a vertical 4:5 flash-sale poster, then add your price yourself in Canva, so the AI doesn't invent offers.

Three: [whispers] zoom in on the logo and every label letter. If something drifts, ask for one fix and redo it from your original photo.

Free plan works, with limits. [curious] Which product are you trying first?

Send this to the friend who sells stuff online.
plan.title: FAKE CHATGPT SLASH COMMANDS
plan.ig_caption:
Those ChatGPT slash commands for product photos? They're just prompts, not real commands. 📸
✅ New chat, tap + and upload one clear snapshot
✅ Paste a prompt: white background, mannequin/display stand, or sale poster
✅ Add "keep shape, color and logo unchanged", then check the logo and label
Which product are you trying first? 👇
Save this for later
Follow @ihackgrowth for daily AI & tech hacks

manual_request.what: Phone screen recording in the ChatGPT app (dark mode): 1) messy, dim phone snapshot of a real product with a visible logo/label on a cluttered table; 2) new chat, tap +, Photos, attach it; 3) paste the white-background prompt, send, show the result; 4) same with the mannequin/display-stand prompt; 5) same with the vertical 4:5 flash-sale poster prompt; 6) open each result full-screen and pinch-zoom on the logo and label text to show they stayed intact.
manual_request.why: The payoff is the real AI-generated photos and the intact logo, which a mock-up can't fake.
